title: NVIDIA fiscal 2027 second-quarter Form 10-Q
excerpt: Fiscal Q2 revenue was $96.221 billion, GAAP net income was $59.688 billion, and diluted EPS was $2.46.
summary: The filing confirms record compute-led growth, a 75.0% GAAP gross margin, strong liquidity, a large working-capital build, higher debt, export-control exposure and sharply larger supply and infrastructure commitments.
